entries.만 12세 이하의 소아는 1회 권장용량을 4~6시간마다 필요시 복용합니다: Children aged 12 years or younger take the recommended single dose every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Take this medicine at the lowest effective dose for the shortest possible period, and do not take more than 5 doses in 1 day (75 mg/kg). If the body weight is known, it is more appropriate to dose according to body weight (10 to 15 mg/kg). Refer to the approved labeling for doses by age group.
